pageDescription: Meet the Data Basis Invited Researchers network: researchers with a PhD, affiliated with universities and research institutes in Brazil and abroad.
heroSubtitle: A network of researchers who collaborate with Data Basis to universalize access to quality data.
aboutText1: The Invited Researchers network brings together researchers from universities and research institutes, in Brazil and abroad, who collaborate with Data Basis.
aboutText2: Members contribute expertise in their research fields, helping to identify, document and improve public data that matter for research and public debate.
eligibilityAffiliation: Be affiliated with a university or research institute, in Brazil or abroad
rosterEmpty: The first cohort of Invited Researchers will be announced soon.
